# SasaVenos Starts Iron Cross Training After 10 To 15 Reps Of Ring Dips

SasaVenos says you can start training the cross when you can comfortably hold the turnout and do 10 to 15 reps with your shoulders [ring dips]. [src: vid-G_c62mhcDic]

## Details

- Start cross training when you can comfortably hold the turnout ring support. [src: vid-G_c62mhcDic]
- You also need 10 to 15 reps of ring dips. [src: vid-G_c62mhcDic]

## Evidence

- vid-G_c62mhcDic (SasaVenos): "it's when you can comfortably hold the turnout And you can also do a couple of reps with your shoulders [ring dips]. So let's say you can do 10 to 15 reps with your shoulders [ring dips]"
